Class CSVHandler

java.lang.Object
Utils.CSVHandler
public class CSVHandler extends Object
Generic CSV Handler for reading and writing CSV files. Provides consistent CSV operations across all factories.

    • updateDataLine

      public void updateDataLine(int dataIndex, String[] newFields)
      Updates a specific data line (excluding header) in the CSV file. dataIndex is zero-based and refers to data rows (header is not counted). Example: dataIndex = 0 updates the first data row (line 2 in file if header exists).
      Parameters:
      dataIndex - index of the data row to update (0-based, excluding header)
      newFields - new fields to write at that row
